t: This is Norfolk Square, a rectangular garden square in Paddington, in the Tyburnia district just north of Hyde Park. It runs east to west from London Street to Norfolk Place, with Praed Street parallel to the north and Sussex Gardens to the south. The classical scholar and poet Walter George Headlam was born on the square. He's remembered for his work on the Mimes of Herodas and was described as one of the leading Greek scholars of his time. Edward Headlam, a lawyer and civil servant, died here in 1882.
